_provenance.preferred_side: the side whose model probability beats the devigged market's

nfl.model: full ensemble where NGS and Elo exist, else rating-only; current vectors; weekly slate de-bias -- the live board since plan 1a
nfl.market: closing spread and prices, nflverse; home side; pushes dropped
nfl.contamination: UPPER BOUND for 2016-2021, the full ensemble's fit seasons; the rating-only vector's window is unrecorded

cfb.model: CFBModel over model/cfb_full_walk_forward_cache.csv (DVOA-only vector; the cache carries no Elo)
cfb.market: spread (closing, CFBD via model/cfb_lines_cache.csv), home side, pushes dropped
cfb.market_price: ASSUMED -110/-110 (p_market = 0.5); the lines carry no prices
cfb.contamination: UPPER BOUND. The DVOA-only vector was fitted on this cache's seasons, so the model is graded partly on data it was fitted to.

nba.week_means: weeks since the season's first graded game
nba.model: NBAModel on NBALiveSource -- the live path, replayed as of one minute before tip
nba.market: spread (closing, ESPN public odds records), home side
nba.contamination: CLEAN OF TUNING: hyperparameters chosen on 2021-2022. 2024-2025 were graded once before for a different question (static vs walk-forward accuracy); this asks a new one, against the market.

nhl.week_means: weeks since the season's first graded game
nhl.model: NHLModel on NHLLiveSource with the goalie-pull and overtime layers -- the live path
nhl.market: moneyline (closing, ESPN public odds records), home side
nhl.contamination: CLEAN OF TUNING: k fixed a priori, zero hyperparameter trials. The rules layer's own constants were fitted before these seasons were graded; see data/nhl_rules.json.

mlb.week_means: weeks since the season's first graded game
mlb.model: MLBModel over model.mlb_model.run_walk_forward with actual starters
mlb.market: moneyline (closing, ESPN public odds records), home side
mlb.contamination: UPPER BOUND. The rules layer was tuned on 2021-2023 and its run-rate constants measured on all five cached seasons, so 2023-2025 are not pristine; 2026 is. An upper bound near zero is a firm zero.
